thread:
maria: Heads-up: I'm taking a quick maintenance window at 02:30 UTC. Need a 15m warm handoff for primary -> secondary. Primary right now is raj, secondary is lucy.

maria: ops-bot, can you post the active pager states and recent alerts?

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-143 (kv-cache evictions spike). Severity: P2. Affected: hosted inference region-us-west. Current pages: 3 failures/sec -> elevated latency. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/kv-cache-spike 

raj: on it. I'm still primary until 02:30, but I have a call at 02:20. Maria, can you take over primary at 02:18?

maria: I can. I'll do a warm handoff at 02:15. Quick checklist:
- confirm keys on the affected pool
- check autoscale activity
- look for deploys matching the window

lucy: I'll be secondary standby. If primary needs to escalate to platform or SRE, page darren first (sre-lead) then platform oncall.

darren: noted. Pager escalation order: primary -> secondary -> sre-lead (darren) -> platform -> eng-manager. For phone escalation (if pager unanswered in 5m) call 555-0199 (on-call escalation line).

maria: During the handoff, let's run these quick commands (paste to terminal):
```
# check cache hit/miss
curl -s "https://metrics.redwood/api/series?metric=kv_cache_hit_rate&region=us-west&last=5m" | jq .
# list recent autoscale events
gcloud compute instance-groups managed operations list --filter="region=us-west && startTime>$(date -d '-10 minutes' --utc +%s)"
```

raj: FYI there's a canary deploy on staging earlier but nothing on prod in last hour. I saw a transient increase in cold starts correlated with cache evictions.

maria: lucy, when I hand off at 02:15 I'll drop a short summary and set primary tag. I'll also snapshot the latest failed request IDs and attach to the incident: INC-2026-143.

lucy: sounds good. If we see sustained error rate > 1% or latency > 800ms, escalate to P1 and page darren immediately.

ops-bot: Alert threshold breached: latency > 800ms for 3 consecutive minutes. Current latency: 920ms.

raj: that's crossing the escalation threshold. Maria, take primary now so I can join my call.

maria: taking primary. Quick notes:
- confirmed eviction burst on pool g4-01
- temporary mitigation: increase cache size quota + enable kv-prefetch on edge nodes (toggle done).
- impact: some customers may see request 5xx or 502s for ~2-4 minutes during mitigation.

maria: paging darren per policy for a potential P1 if mitigation doesn't reduce errors within 5m. @darren please standby.

darren: received. I'll review the service logs and the kernel OOM/disk activity. If we need infra assist, I'll open a dedicated infra escalation channel and bring in platform-ops.

lucy: running a quick eval prompt set to check quality regressions tied to cache fallback. If reranks degrade, we might route traffic to the cheaper low-latency variant.

maria: decision log: temporary routing to model-variant-b (quantized) if tail latency > 1000ms for two minutes. We'll revert when stable.

ops-bot: Action taken: routing rule engaged -> model-variant-b for 12% traffic.

raj: thanks. Two operational items for handoff notes: 1) primary token for restart is in the vault (oncall/shared), 2) if you need to roll the pool, use the canary first with 10% traffic.

maria: noted. I'll add those to the incident body. Also adding SLA note: estimated customer impact window 02:12-02:30 UTC, likely affecting 2.3% of active sessions.

lucy: if customer escalations come in, refer support to incidentINC-2026-143, share the mitigation steps and expected ETA 20m.

maria: handoff complete: primary=mar ia (now), secondary=lucy. Next check-in 02:25.

raj: thanks, team. I'll stay reachable but stepping into the other call.

maria: 02:19 update: latency down to 420ms, error rate 0.3%. ops-bot please log status and close routing rule when stable.

ops-bot: Status logged: latency reduction observed. Routing rule remains active. Will auto-clear if metrics stable for 10m.

lucy: all good on secondary. If it regresses, page me directly with reason code: REQ-KV-001.

maria: If we need to escalate to a P1, remember to include: incident start time, affected customers list, mitigation steps, rollback plan, and SLA impact calc in the first 10m summary.

darren: acknowledged. If platform intervention required, I'll create a bridge and invite infra-engineers: @platform-oncall, @storage-oncall.

maria: closing notes to leave in the handoff doc:
- short description, root cause hypothesis (cache eviction storm), mitigation applied, routing fallback, contact list, phone escalate number, follow-up actions (increase cache quota permanently, add prefetch on more edges, postmortem owner).

maria: thanks all. warming down to monitoring-only.

ops-bot: Incident INC-2026-143 updated: primary set to maria, severity remains P2.

lucy: nice handoff. :thumbsup:

maria: leaving final comment in the runbook and marking shift at 02:30.

maria: end of thread
